title: AION Individual Runtime Context
description: Language-neutral identity and lineage contract for one individual runtime instance. This contract records ownership references; it does not establish subjectivity, consciousness, identity continuity, phenomenal continuity, canonical authority, or deployment authority.

agent_id.description: Non-empty identity owner reference. The AION or Astra composition boundary, not this generic schema, must bind the value to its authorized identity.

runtime_instance_id.description: Non-empty identifier for the concrete runtime instance producing or consuming the record.

memory_stream_id.description: Non-empty governed memory stream or namespace reference associated with the runtime instance.

event_lineage_id.description: Non-empty persistent event-lineage reference for the runtime instance.

canonical_state_reference.description: Non-empty reference to the separately governed canonical-state domain; its presence does not grant canonical effect.

genesis_root_id.description: Non-empty shared or individually governed genesis-root reference, subject to higher-level authorization.
